order: run rollback regression and read-only health checks

scope: No raw user content, tokens or identifiers. No model-quality or real speech claims. rollback_note: New database requires provider-attempt generation. Do not revert only the API to v7; keep a generation-aware API and prefer a tested forward fix. Pre-migration function definitions are backed up outside the public repository.
